sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xiǎng gěi zuì xǐhuan de Wáng lǎoshī zuò yī zhāng kǎpiàn, kěshì tā juéde zìjǐ xiě de zì bù hǎokàn.
sentences.english: Xiaoming wanted to make a card for his favorite Teacher Wang, but he felt his handwriting wasn't good-looking.

sentences.pinyin: Jiějie Lìli zhīdào le, duì tā shuō: "Bié dānxīn, wǒ lái bāng nǐ xiě hànzì. Nǐ xiǎng duì lǎoshī shuō shénme ne?"
sentences.english: His older sister Lili found out and said to him, "Don't worry, I'll help you write the Chinese characters. What would you like to say to the teacher?"

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng xiě: Lǎoshī, xièxie nín! Nín jiāo wǒmen Zhōngwén, wǒmen dōu xǐhuan nín."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "I want to write: Teacher, thank you! You teach us Chinese, and we all like you."

sentences.pinyin: Lìli xiàolexiào, bāng tā zài kǎpiàn shang xiěhǎole jǐ gè piàoliang de hànzì.
sentences.english: Lili smiled and helped him write several beautiful Chinese characters on the card.

sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu, tāmen yīqǐ láidào huāyuán, xuǎnle yīxiē hěn hǎokàn de huār.
sentences.english: Then, they went to the garden together and picked some very pretty flowers.

sentences.pinyin: Dì-èr tiān zǎoshang, Xiǎomíng dàizhe kǎpiàn hé huār láidào xuéxiào.
sentences.english: The next morning, Xiaoming came to school with the card and the flowers.
Before class, Xiaoming was a little nervous.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshēng de duì Wáng lǎoshī shuō: "Lǎoshī, Jiàoshījié kuàilè! Zhè shì wǒ hé jiějie sòng gěi nín de."
sentences.english: He said softly to Teacher Wang, "Teacher, Happy Teachers' Day! This is from my sister and me."

sentences.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī kànlekàn kǎpiàn hé huār, gāoxìng de xiàole: "Xièxie nǐ, Xiǎomíng! Kǎpiàn shang de zì xiě de zhēn hǎokàn, huār yě hěn piàoliang. Wǒ hěn xǐhuan."
sentences.english: Teacher Wang looked at the card and the flowers and smiled happily, "Thank you, Xiaoming! The handwriting on the card is really beautiful, and the flowers are very pretty too. I like them very much."

sentences.pinyin: Tīngle lǎoshī de huà, Xiǎomíng gāoxìng jí le.
sentences.english: Hearing the teacher's words, Xiaoming was overjoyed.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng: Yǐhòu wǒ yào gèng nǔlì xuéxí, ràng lǎoshī tiāntiān dōu gāoxìng.
sentences.english: He thought: In the future, I will study even harder to make Teacher happy every day.
